abort_reason.what_happened: During metadata-only candidate verification for ACKO, opening official prospectus sources to confirm UIN/current eligibility returned target-clause content before a Product #6 selection record was committed. The Arogya Sanjeevani prospectus response exposed waiting-period clauses. The ACKO Surrogacy & Oocyte Cover prospectus response also exposed a waiting-period clause while its UIN was being resolved.
abort_reason.why_abort_is_required: The v3 protocol makes preselection_target_clause_reads a zero-tolerance primary metric. Once non-zero, Product #6 cannot serve as a clean neutral repeatability proof even though the semantic content was not used for selection.

metadata_progress_before_abort.basis: current insurer-universe ordering and v3.1 insurer-first deterministic stopping rule

archived_lower_uin_observation.product_name: ACKO Retail Health Policy / Acko Health Insurance Policy
archived_lower_uin_observation.selection_effect: not eligible as a current candidate

next_neutral_attempt_requirements.reason_for_ACKO_exclusion: Multiple ACKO candidate sources exposed target-concept material during the aborted Product #6 preselection screen; excluding the insurer prevents contaminated knowledge from influencing the replacement neutral attempt.
next_neutral_attempt_requirements.metadata_source_restriction: Before selection, use only non-policy metadata surfaces such as regulator insurer lists, insurer product/disclaimer lists, product catalogue pages, and UIN tables. Do not open policy wordings, prospectuses, CIS documents, proposal forms, or search results whose returned content contains policy clauses.
